quarters.supplementaryReportName: Q4 2024 Capital and Liquidity Measures table (within earnings release)

notes.roe: reported ROE used (11.4%); adjusted ROE was notably lower (7.4%) this quarter due to a large positive one-time item (reversal of a prior legal provision) boosting reported income above adjusted income
notes.efficiencyRatio: reported efficiency ratio (49.4%), unusually low this quarter due to the same one-time reported-income boost; adjusted efficiency ratio was 58.3%
notes.loansToAssetsPct: Computed: net loans and acceptances at Oct 31 2024 ($678,375M, from the BMO Q1 2025 Report to Shareholders balance sheet prior-year-end column) ÷ total assets ($1,409,647M).
notes.loanToDepositRatio: Computed: gross loans $682,372mm (Table 26, Net Loans) ÷ total deposits $982,440mm (Table 27, Deposits), both as at Oct 31, 2024. Not a figure BMO discloses directly as a ratio.
notes.wholesaleFundingPct: BMO's own disclosed 'Total secured and unsecured wholesale funding outstanding' of $255,511mm (Table 53, Wholesale Funding Maturities) ÷ total assets $1,409,647mm. Scope note: BMO explicitly states this figure excludes repo transactions and bankers' acceptances. It includes interbank deposits, CP/CD, bearer deposit notes, ABCP, senior unsecured MTNs/structured notes, mortgage/HELOC securitizations, covered bonds, other ABS, FHLB advances, and subordinated debt. Including repo ($110,791mm) per the broader task definition raises this to ~25.99% — the narrower, BMO-defined figure is reported as primary.
notes.retailDepositsPct: Individuals deposits $330,413mm ÷ total deposits $982,440mm (Table 27, as at Oct 31, 2024, as originally reported in the FY2024 AIF). Note: BMO's FY2025 AIF later reclassified/restated this comparative to $320,767mm and introduced a new 'Deposits at FVTPL' line not broken out in the original FY2024 filing — the figure here uses the as-originally-disclosed FY2024 classification.
notes.wholesaleDepositsPct: (Banks $33,266mm + Businesses and governments $618,761mm) ÷ total deposits $982,440mm, as originally reported for FY2024.
notes.stableDepositsPct: From BMO's LCR disclosure (Table 55, as at Oct 31, 2024, quarterly-average unweighted values): Stable deposits $139.9B. Denominator = sum of the four LCR deposit categories in the same table (Retail Stable + Retail Less Stable + Operational + Non-operational = $595.8B), not the balance-sheet total deposits figure, since the LCR table captures only deposits/funding subject to the 30-day outflow horizon.
notes.lessStableDepositsPct: Less stable deposits $162.4B ÷ $595.8B (same LCR Table 55 basis as stableDepositsPct).
notes.operationalDepositsPct: Operational deposits (all counterparties) and deposits in networks of cooperative banks, $153.5B ÷ $595.8B (same LCR Table 55 basis).
notes.nonOperationalDepositsPct: Non-operational deposits (all counterparties) $140.0B ÷ $595.8B (same LCR Table 55 basis). LCR table also separately shows 'Unsecured debt' of $19.2B and 'Secured wholesale funding' (weighted only, $23.0B), excluded from this deposits-only denominator.
notes.irrbbEveSensitivityPct: BMO does not disclose the 6-scenario Basel/OSFI IRRBB1 template at the consolidated enterprise level (confirmed absent from BMO's and CIBC's OSFI Pillar 3 disclosures alike). Its Annual Report/AIF Market Risk section (Table 45, 'Structural Interest Rate Sensitivity', as at Oct 31, 2024) discloses only 2 of the 6 scenarios: an immediate parallel +100bp and -100bp shift, constant balance sheet, pre-tax C$. More adverse scenario (+100bp): Economic Value Sensitivity Total = -$1,483mm ÷ Tier 1 Capital $64,735mm (Table 30, CC1) = -2.29%. Computed ratio; BMO does not itself express EVE sensitivity as % of Tier 1 capital.
notes.irrbbNiiSensitivityPct: Most adverse (-100bp) 12-month NII sensitivity $-210M ÷ Tier 1 capital $64,735M = -0.32%. Re-based to % of Tier 1 capital (from the earlier % of annual NII) to match the cross-bank convention used by RBC/TD/CIBC/National.
notes.newMetricsSource: BMO 2024 Annual Report / Annual Information Form (Exhibit 99.2 to Form 40-F) — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/927971/000119312524271395/d878486dex992.htm

notes.dividendPayoutRatio: Reported basis, from BMO's Supplementary Financial Information (line 23). BMO also publishes an adjusted payout ratio on line 24, which differs materially in some quarters.

notes.totalCapitalRatio: Total capital ratio %, Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders capital table (Q2-2026). Anchors: Q1-2026=16.9 and Q2-2025=17.9 both match our existing values.
notes.lcr: Average daily LCR for the quarter ended April 30, 2026 = 128%, stated in the Liquidity and Funding Risk section of the Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders.
notes.nsfr: NSFR = 114% as at April 30, 2026 (a $95.2B surplus above the 100% minimum), stated in the Liquidity and Funding Risk section of the Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders.
notes.roe: reported ROE used (13.0%); adjusted ROE was 13.5%
notes.nim: Net interest margin on average earning assets %, Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders Financial Highlights (Table 1, Q2-2026). Whole-bank basis (BMO also discloses an 'excluding Global Markets and Insurance' NIM of 2.29% — not used here for consistency).
notes.loansToAssetsPct: Computed: net loans and acceptances ($679,945M) ÷ total assets ($1,499,543M) as at April 30, 2026, from the Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders Consolidated Balance Sheet. Consistent with the net-loans/total-assets method used for other banks.
notes.retailDepositsPct: Individuals (personal) deposits $294,037M ÷ total deposits $966,901M, from the BMO Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders Deposits note + balance sheet.
notes.wholesaleDepositsPct: Bank ($32,565M) + Business & government ($577,833M) deposits ÷ total deposits $966,901M, BMO Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders Deposits note. (Any remainder to 100% is deposits at FVTPL, not classified by depositor type.)
notes.loanToDepositRatio: Gross loans and acceptances $685,009M ÷ total deposits $966,901M, BMO Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders balance sheet.
notes.irrbbEveSensitivityPct: Most adverse of BMO's two disclosed shocks (+100bp / -100bp parallel) Economic Value Sensitivity, Total = $-2059M, ÷ Tier 1 capital $65,410M = -3.15%. From the Structural Interest Rate Sensitivity table in the BMO Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders — BMO discloses this quarterly (not only annually). Normalized to % of Tier 1 capital for cross-bank comparability.
notes.irrbbNiiSensitivityPct: Most adverse of BMO's two disclosed shocks Earnings (12-month NII) Sensitivity, Total = $-282M, ÷ Tier 1 capital $65,410M = -0.43%. Structural Interest Rate Sensitivity table, BMO Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders (quarterly disclosure). Normalized to % of Tier 1 capital to match the RBC/TD/CIBC/National convention.
notes.stableDepositsPct: Stable deposits: unweighted average $139.7B ÷ sum of the four LCR deposit categories ($609.3B) = 22.93%. From the LCR common disclosure template in the BMO Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders (quarterly average). BMO discloses this template quarterly.
notes.lessStableDepositsPct: Less stable deposits: unweighted average $157.9B ÷ sum of the four LCR deposit categories ($609.3B) = 25.91%. From the LCR common disclosure template in the BMO Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders (quarterly average). BMO discloses this template quarterly.
notes.operationalDepositsPct: Operational deposits (all counterparties): unweighted average $166.2B ÷ sum of the four LCR deposit categories ($609.3B) = 27.28%. From the LCR common disclosure template in the BMO Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders (quarterly average). BMO discloses this template quarterly.
notes.nonOperationalDepositsPct: Non-operational deposits (all counterparties): unweighted average $145.5B ÷ sum of the four LCR deposit categories ($609.3B) = 23.88%. From the LCR common disclosure template in the BMO Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders (quarterly average). BMO discloses this template quarterly.
notes.wholesaleFundingPct: BMO's own disclosed "Total secured and unsecured wholesale funding outstanding" of $264.6 billion (Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders, Liquidity and Funding Risk narrative) ÷ total assets $1499.5 billion = 17.65%. Same scope as BMO's annual figure: excludes repo transactions and bankers' acceptances. BMO discloses this headline figure every quarter.
notes.tlacLeverageRatio: TLAC as a percentage of leverage ratio exposure, per OSFI's TLAC guideline. Cross-checked against an overlapping supplementary/Pillar 3 disclosure.
notes.dividendPayoutRatio: Reported basis, from BMO's Supplementary Financial Information (line 23). BMO also publishes an adjusted payout ratio on line 24, which differs materially in some quarters.

irrbbDisclosureNote: BMO discloses interest rate risk in the banking book every quarter, in the Structural (Non-Trading) Market Risk section of its Report to Shareholders (and Annual Report) under 'Structural Interest Rate Sensitivity'. It shows 2 of the 6 Basel shock scenarios — an immediate parallel +100bp and -100bp shift (rates floored at zero, constant balance sheet) — reporting both Economic Value Sensitivity (ΔEVE) and 12-month Earnings Sensitivity (ΔNII), split by Canada and the United States, pre-tax in C$ millions. BMO does not itself express these as a percentage of Tier 1 capital; the %-of-Tier-1 figures in this dataset are computed by dividing BMO's disclosed dollar sensitivities by its Tier 1 capital, matching the normalization used for the other banks.
irrbbDisclosureSourceName: BMO Q2 2026 Report to Shareholders, Structural (Non-Trading) Market Risk — Structural Interest Rate Sensitivity (Table 27)
